newsitem.title: USA: US Chamber of Commerce confidence index up in Aug.
newsitem.headline: US Chamber of Commerce confidence index up in Aug.

text.p: The U.S. Chamber of Commerce on Monday said its Business Confidence Index, a bi-monthly measure of the outlook for economic growth, employment and sales, rose in August.
The index increased to 54.8 in August from 54.3 in June. In April, it stood at 56.2.

"The business confidence index edged up slightly in August but failed to make up the ground it lost in June," said Martin Regalia, chief economist for the Chamber of Commerce. "As such, the index is consistent with our expectations that the economy will slow somewhat in the second half from its rapid first-half pace."
